ticker: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia as AI stocks rally
5.3 magnitude earthquake strikes Nepal, tremors hit India
India announces $1.62B aid package for flood-hit Nepal
NATO deploys early-warning aircraft to Poland
Tajikistan exits ICC amid growing diplomatic pressures

articles.headline: Asian Stocks Rally as Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia
articles.brief: Asian markets experienced a significant boost as Jensen Huang returned to helm Nvidia, reviving the broader artificial intelligence trade and inspiring strong investor confidence across regional stock exchanges.

articles.headline: India Announces $1.62 Billion Package for Nepal
articles.brief: India has committed a major $1.62 billion financial and infrastructural package to bolster ties with flood-hit Nepal, targeting trade, rail links, hydropower projects, and comprehensive regional development.

articles.headline: NATO Deploys Early-Warning Aircraft to Poland
articles.brief: Following a serious missile incident near the border, NATO announced the deployment of specialized early-warning system aircraft to Poland to enhance airspace surveillance and regional defense readiness.

articles.headline: Tajikistan Withdraws from ICC Following US Diplomatic Push
articles.brief: Tajikistan has officially become the fourth nation to withdraw from the International Criminal Court, following an intensive diplomatic initiative led by the United States.

articles.headline: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship for Developers
articles.brief: AI firm Anthropic has rolled out a new developer tool named Claude Ship, designed to streamline coding processes and help engineering teams ship software products faster.

articles.headline: Earthquake of Magnitude 5.3 Strikes Nepal
articles.brief: A 5.3 magnitude earthquake jolted Nepal's Koshi province near the Chinese border, triggering distinct tremors across parts of North Bengal, Sikkim, and neighboring regions.

articles.headline: Man Arrested After Stabbing Nine Police in Delhi
articles.brief: A 30-year-old individual stabbed nine police personnel during twin knife attacks in the vicinity of Delhi's Jama Masjid before being shot and apprehended by law enforcement.

articles.headline: China Mega Dam Project Near Arunachal Raises Concerns
articles.brief: Recent satellite data reveals significant construction progress on China's massive 60 GW Medog hydropower project near the border, sparking downstream environmental concerns in India.

articles.headline: Ball-Tampering Allegations Surface From 2018 Australia Test
articles.brief: New historical reports indicate that Australian players discussed using mints for ball-tampering during a 2018 Test against Pakistan before team leadership intervened to stop it.

articles.headline: China to Launch Pakistani Astronaut on Shenzhou-24
articles.brief: In a milestone international space partnership, China announced plans to send a Pakistani astronaut aboard the upcoming Shenzhou-24 mission to its space station.

articles.headline: Banks Roll Out Relief Measures for Agri Loan Stress
articles.brief: Facing deficient monsoon conditions and agricultural stress, lenders across multiple states are rolling out relief measures and loan recasts to protect a ₹12 trillion farm book.

articles.headline: IMD Issues Heavy Rain Alerts for Southern India
articles.brief: The India Meteorological Department has issued heavy rainfall alerts for coastal areas of Tamil Nadu and Kerala through November 27, while temperatures begin dropping across North India.

articles.headline: New Haven Agrees to $30 Million Wrongful Conviction Settlement
articles.brief: The city of New Haven has agreed to a $30 million settlement resolving the wrongful murder convictions of two men who spent decades behind bars before being exonerated.

articles.headline: Euler Motors in Talks to Raise $150 Million
articles.brief: Commercial electric vehicle manufacturer Euler Motors is currently in advanced discussions to raise between $100 million and $150 million at a valuation approaching $500 million.
